feature.zh: 正在压缩上下文，请稍后… / 正在修复压缩摘要，请稍后…
feature.en: Compacting context, please wait… / Repairing the compacted summary, please wait…
feature.statusSource: contextInspector.idleStatus → compactionPhase + compactionTrigger from the engine's live CompactPhase
feature.polling: 1s while compacting, 5s otherwise; no model call and no session write
feature.rationale: Only the automatic pre-request path is announced by the composer; idle maintenance and confirmed manual runs stay in the Context panel so the line never claims work the reader did not trigger by sending a message.

fullSuite.failureCause: All 11 failures are node-addon-system ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED (local native module code-signature Team ID mismatch). The same failures reproduce on a clean e381e09 worktree (idle-recovery 0/9 pass) with no 0.10.9 changes applied, so they are pre-existing environment failures, not regressions.

nativeInstallation.note: Host-side status plumbing is new, so the running Host must restart before the line can appear; a client-only reload would still talk to the old Host status shape.

scope: Static and packaged-candidate verification only. The native GUI appearance of the line during a real automatic pre-request compaction has not been observed yet; it remains unverified until the Host restarts and one automatic compaction runs.
